north.evidence: Bisht, Fig.1, upper right: exact label 'N' above a compass rose and arrow. No true, magnetic or grid qualification is printed in the figure.

manual_reason: We pick the exposed solid black Harappan Defences faces distinguished by the legend. The short separated exposures, abutting structures, scanning blur and text overlaps make an automatic profile liable to follow another line. Endpoint sigma is three pixels at 300 dpi.
